packs.name: 20-minute dinners
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Home-made dinners on the table in 20 minutes or less, with ingredients from any supermarket: omelettes, scrambled eggs, pasta, griddled fish, chicken stir-fry, vegetable soups, hearty salads and quick pizzas. For the days when you don't feel like a fuss.

packs.name: Air fryer
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Recipes made for the air fryer: chips, wings, home-made nuggets, breaded fish, crispy vegetables, meatballs, burgers, ribs and even desserts. With very little oil and the time and temperature for each dish. Times are a guide: every model heats differently.

packs.name: World cuisine: United States
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: American home cooking, from the South to New England: mac and cheese, pulled pork, fried chicken, clam chowder, chili, cornbread, pancakes, meatloaf, jambalaya, gumbo, coleslaw, apple pie, chocolate chip cookies, New York cheesecake, cheesesteak, Cobb salad and key lime pie. With measurements in grams.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Anglo-Indian
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Dishes born where India and Britain met, from the clubs and trains of the Raj to British curry houses: kedgeree, mulligatawny soup, chicken tikka masala, coronation chicken, jalfrezi, railway mutton curry, country captain and mango chutney.

packs.name: World cuisine: Argentina
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: From the asado to afternoon tea: beef short ribs, chimichurri, salsa criolla, choripán, provoleta, criolla empanadas, milanesa a la napolitana, locro, matambre, humita, carbonada, gnocchi with tuco, pastel de papa, revuelto gramajo, dulce de leche, alfajores, pastafrola, medialunas, tortas fritas and chipá.

packs.name: Arroces
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Paellas, arroces secos, melosos y caldosos y arroces del mundo: paella de marisco, mixta y de verduras, arroz del señoret, a banda, con conejo y caracoles, con costra, caldoso de bogavante, meloso de setas, empedrado, huertano, a la cubana, pilaf, biryani, risotto de calabaza, gallo pinto, arroz con gandules y jollof. Y ninguna paella lleva chorizo.

packs.name: Bakery
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Bread and pastries to make at home, from sourdough starter to madeleines: sourdough loaf, baguette, sandwich loaf, wholemeal, rye, chapata, walnut and raisin bread, pitta, naan, bagels, burger buns, milk rolls, brioche, croissants, pains au chocolat, ensaïmadas, tortas de aceite, Spanish magdalenas and anise rosquillas. With exact weights and proving times.

packs.name: Cenas en 20 minutos
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Cenas caseras que están en la mesa en 20 minutos o menos, con ingredientes de cualquier supermercado: tortillas, revueltos, pasta, pescado a la plancha, wok de pollo, cremas de verduras, ensaladas completas y pizzas exprés. Para los días en que no apetece complicarse.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Chifa
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The cooking of Cantonese immigrants in Peru, which spread from Lima's Chinatown to the whole country with the wok, soy sauce and Peruvian produce: tallarín saltado, chi jau kay, kam lu wantán, aeropuerto, pollo enrollado, fried wontons, pork with tamarind and fuchifú soup.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Chinese-American
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The cooking Chinese immigrants created in the United States, the food of the takeout box: General Tso's chicken, orange chicken, beef and broccoli, chop suey, egg foo young, crab rangoon, Mongolian beef and lo mein.

packs.name: World cuisine: China
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Classics from Sichuan, Cantonese and northern Chinese cooking: kung pao chicken, mapo tofu, jiaozi, sweet and sour pork, hot and sour soup, wontons, chow mein, hong shao rou, dan dan noodles, char siu, steamed fish, spring rolls and congee. With the basic sauces and spices of the Chinese pantry.

packs.name: Christmas special
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Timeless recipes for Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and Twelfth Night: prawn cocktail, ham croquettes, galets soup, roast lamb, suckling pig, sea bream, hake in green sauce, red cabbage, roscón de Reyes, turrón, polvorones and marzipan. With notes for cooking ahead and for big gatherings.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Alemania
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Los clásicos de la cocina alemana de norte a sur: schnitzel, rouladen, sauerbraten, ensalada de patata suaba, bratkartoffeln, kartoffelpuffer, käsespätzle, königsberger klopse, currywurst, frikadellen, potajes de lentejas y de guisantes, sopa de patata, flammkuchen, brezeln, maultaschen, obatzda y postres como el pastel de manzana, la tarta Selva Negra y la rote grütze.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Argentina
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Del asado a la merienda: tira de asado, chimichurri, salsa criolla, choripán, provoleta, empanadas criollas, milanesa a la napolitana, locro, matambre arrollado, humita, carbonada, ñoquis con tuco, pastel de papa, revuelto gramajo, dulce de leche, alfajores de maicena, pastafrola, medialunas, tortas fritas y chipá.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: China
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Clásicos de las cocinas de Sichuan, Cantón y el norte de China: pollo kung pao, mapo tofu, jiaozi, cerdo agridulce, sopa agripicante, wonton, chow mein, hong shao rou, dan dan mian, char siu, pescado al vapor, rollitos de primavera y congee. Con las salsas y especias básicas de la despensa china.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Colombia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina de las regiones de Colombia: bandeja paisa, frijoles antioqueños, ajiaco santafereño, sancocho, arepas, empanadas, patacones, hogao, ají, arroz con pollo, changua, pandebono, buñuelos, natilla, posta negra cartagenera, mote de queso, arroz con coco, cazuela de mariscos, sobrebarriga y limonada de coco. Con equivalencias para los ingredientes menos habituales fuera de Colombia.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: España
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Un recorrido por las cocinas regionales de España: cocido madrileño, fabada, lentejas, marmitako, bacalao al pil pil, pollo al ajillo, arroz negro, fideuá, arroz al horno, escalivada, patatas a la riojana, caldo gallego, papas arrugadas con mojo, ajoblanco, empanada gallega, migas, rabo de toro, torrijas, arroz con leche y tarta de Santiago. Sin repetir los platos de los packs de cocina mediterránea, tapas y Navidad.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Estados Unidos
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina casera de Estados Unidos, del sur a Nueva Inglaterra: macarrones con queso, cerdo desmenuzado, pollo frito, sopa de almejas, chili, pan de maíz, tortitas, pastel de carne, jambalaya, gumbo, ensalada de col, tarta de manzana, galletas con pepitas de chocolate, tarta de queso de Nueva York, cheesesteak, ensalada Cobb y tarta de lima. Con medidas en gramos.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Grecia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina griega más allá de la ensalada y el tzatziki: souvlaki, spanakopita, pastitsio, gemista, fasolada, avgolemono, dolmades, keftedes, briam, fava, kleftiko, stifado, queso saganaki, gambas con feta, gigantes, taramosalata, melitzanosalata, spanakorizo, loukoumades y baklava. Con aceite de oliva, limón, orégano y eneldo.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: India
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Curris, legumbres, panes y dulces de la India: pollo a la mantequilla, pollo tandoori, rogan josh, korma, vindaloo, palak paneer, chana masala, dal tadka, rajma, aloo gobi, baingan bharta, samosas, bhajis de cebolla, raita, chutney de menta, chapatis, aloo paratha, kheer, lassi de mango y masala chai.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Indonesia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Los platos de diario y de fiesta de Indonesia: nasi goreng, mie goreng, satay de pollo con salsa de cacahuete, gado-gado, rendang, soto ayam, opor ayam, bakso, sayur lodeh, sambal y postres como el pisang goreng, el martabak o los klepon. Con equivalencias para los ingredientes menos habituales.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Italia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Los grandes clásicos de las regiones de Italia: carbonara, amatriciana, cacio e pepe, lasaña, pasta alla Norma, espaguetis con almejas, risotto a la milanesa, ossobuco, saltimbocca, parmigiana, minestrone, pasta e fagioli, pizza margarita, focaccia, arancini, vitello tonnato, caponata, puttanesca, orecchiette con grelos, ñoquis a la sorrentina, pollo a la cazadora, ribollita, panzanella, carpaccio, calzone, tiramisú, panna cotta, cannoli y cantucci. Hechos como en Italia, sin nata en la carbonara.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Japón
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina casera de Japón: sopa de miso, pollo teriyaki, gyoza, ramen, tonkatsu, oyakodon, onigiri, tamagoyaki, okonomiyaki, yakitori, tempura, makis, karaage, nikujaga, yakisoba, gyudon, curry japonés y dorayaki. Con el dashi y las salsas de base explicados paso a paso.

packs.name: Cocina mediterránea
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Recetas de las orillas del Mediterráneo: España, Italia, Grecia, Líbano, Marruecos y Túnez. Gazpacho, paella, tortilla, musaka, hummus, falafel, shakshuka, risotto, tajín y más, con aceite de oliva, verduras de temporada y legumbres.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: México
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Clásicos de México para cocinar en casa: tacos al pastor, cochinita pibil, pozole, chilaquiles, enchiladas, salsas, guacamole, aguas frescas y flan. Con ingredientes fáciles de encontrar y alternativas cuando hace falta.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Perú
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina peruana de la costa, la sierra y la herencia chifa: ceviche, tiradito, lomo saltado, ají de gallina, causa limeña, papa a la huancaína, ocopa, arroz chaufa, anticuchos, pollo a la brasa, rocoto relleno, seco de res, arroz con pollo, chupe de camarones, papa rellena, tallarines verdes, suspiro limeño, picarones, mazamorra morada y chicha morada. Con equivalencias para los ajíes peruanos.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Tailandia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: El equilibrio tailandés entre picante, ácido, dulce y salado: pad thai, tom yum, tom kha gai, curris verde, massaman y panang, som tam, larb, arroz frito, pad kra pao, pad see ew, pollo con anacardos, ensalada de ternera, tortitas de pescado, tortilla tailandesa, khao man gai, gai yang, salsa jaew, mango con arroz glutinoso y té tailandés. Con equivalencias para los ingredientes menos habituales.

packs.name: Cocina del mundo: Vietnam
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina fresca y aromática de Vietnam, de Hanói a Saigón: phở, bún chả, bánh mì, rollitos frescos y fritos, bún bò Huế, cơm tấm, pescado y cerdo caramelizados, sopa agria, bò lúc lắc, pollo con citronela, bánh xèo, ensalada de pollo, bún thịt nướng, nước chấm, tofu con tomate y, de postre, plátano con coco, café con leche condensada y batido de aguacate.

packs.name: World cuisine: Colombia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Cooking from Colombia's regions: bandeja paisa, Antioquian beans, ajiaco, sancocho, arepas, empanadas, patacones, hogao, ají, arroz con pollo, changua, pandebono, buñuelos, natilla, posta negra, mote de queso, coconut rice, seafood casserole, sobrebarriga and coconut lemonade. With substitutes for the ingredients that are harder to find outside Colombia.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Creole
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The Creole cooking of New Orleans, where France, Spain, West Africa and the Caribbean met: shrimp Creole, red beans and rice, crawfish étouffée, grillades and grits, dirty rice, muffuletta, beignets and bread pudding with whiskey sauce.

packs.name: Especial Navidad
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Las recetas de siempre para Nochebuena, Navidad y Reyes: cóctel de gambas, croquetas, sopa de galets, cordero asado, cochinillo, besugo, merluza en salsa verde, lombarda, roscón de Reyes, turrones, polvorones y mazapanes. Con notas para adelantar trabajo y cocinar para mucha gente.

packs.name: Freidora de aire
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Recetas pensadas para la freidora de aire: patatas, alitas, nuggets caseros, pescado rebozado, verduras crujientes, albóndigas, hamburguesas, costillas y hasta postres. Con muy poco aceite y los tiempos y temperaturas de cada plato. Los tiempos son orientativos: cada modelo calienta de forma distinta.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: anglo-india
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Los platos nacidos del encuentro entre la India y Gran Bretaña, de los clubes y trenes del Raj a los restaurantes de curry británicos: kedgeree, sopa mulligatawny, pollo tikka masala, pollo coronación, jalfrezi, curry de cordero del ferrocarril, country captain y chutney de mango.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chifa
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina de los inmigrantes cantoneses en Perú, que desde el barrio chino de Lima llegó a todo el país con el wok, la soja y los productos peruanos: tallarín saltado, chi jau kay, kam lu wantán, aeropuerto, pollo enrollado, wantanes fritos, chancho con tamarindo y sopa fuchifú.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chino-coreana
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Los platos de los restaurantes chinos de Corea, creados por inmigrantes de Shandong en Incheon y que se piden a domicilio en todo el país: jajangmyeon, jjamppong, tangsuyuk, kkanpunggi, lajogi, yusanseul, gun-mandu y goguma mattang.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chino-estadounidense
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina que crearon los inmigrantes chinos en Estados Unidos y que llena las cajas de comida para llevar: pollo del general Tso, pollo a la naranja, ternera con brócoli, chop suey, egg foo young, crab rangoon, ternera mongola y lo mein.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chino-india
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina indochina, nacida entre los chinos hakka de Calcuta y hoy en todos los puestos callejeros de la India: gobi manchurian, pollo al chile, fideos hakka, arroz frito schezwan, paneer al chile, sopa manchow, sopa de maíz dulce y patatas con miel y chile.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chino-japonesa
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: El chūka ryōri, la cocina china a la japonesa de los barrios chinos de Yokohama y Nagasaki y de los restaurantes de barrio: chāhan, tenshinhan, ebi chili, ebi mayo, hiyashi chūka, champon de Nagasaki, shūmai y nira reba.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: chino-malaya
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina de los chinos de Malasia (hokkien, cantoneses, hainaneses y hakka) en los puestos de comida de Penang y Kuala Lumpur: char kway teow, bak kut teh, hokkien mee, yong tau foo, arroz con pollo en cazuela de barro, wantan mee, chuleta de pollo hainanesa y tostadas con kaya.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: criolla
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina criolla de Nueva Orleans, donde se mezclaron Francia, España, África occidental y el Caribe: gambas a la criolla, alubias rojas con arroz, étouffée de cangrejo de río, grillades con sémola de maíz, arroz sucio, muffuletta, beignets y pudin de pan con salsa de whisky.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: italoestadounidense
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina de los inmigrantes italianos en Nueva York, Nueva Jersey y San Francisco, más generosa en carne, queso y salsa que la de Italia: espaguetis con albóndigas, pollo a la parmesana, penne alla vodka, fettuccine Alfredo, ziti al horno, gambas scampi, cioppino y sopa de boda italiana.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: ítalo-peruana
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Lo que dejaron en la mesa peruana los inmigrantes ligures del siglo XIX, mezclado con ajíes, papas y quesos andinos: tallarines rojos, tallarines a la huancaína con lomo saltado, menestrón, pastel de acelga, ñoquis de papa amarilla y panetón.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: peranakan
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina nyonya de los peranakan, descendientes de chinos y malayos de Malaca, Penang y Singapur, que mezcla técnicas chinas con especias, coco y tamarindo: laksa lemak, asam laksa, ayam pongteh, ayam buah keluak, otak-otak, kueh pie tee, chap chye y kuih dadar.

packs.name: Cocina fusión: Tex-Mex
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: La cocina de los tejanos de origen mexicano, con más queso amarillo, comino y carne de ternera que la de México: nachos, chile con queso, enchiladas de queso con chili gravy, tacos crujientes de carne, tacos de desayuno, pollo King Ranch, frito pie y sopaipillas.

packs.name: World cuisine: Germany
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: German classics from north to south: schnitzel, rouladen, sauerbraten, Swabian potato salad, Bratkartoffeln, Kartoffelpuffer, Käsespätzle, Königsberger Klopse, currywurst, Frikadellen, lentil and split pea stews, potato soup, Flammkuchen, pretzels, Maultaschen, Obatzda and sweets such as apple cake, Black Forest gateau and rote Grütze.

packs.name: World cuisine: Greece
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Greek cooking beyond the salad and tzatziki: souvlaki, spanakopita, pastitsio, gemista, fasolada, avgolemono, dolmades, keftedes, briam, fava, kleftiko, stifado, saganaki cheese, prawns with feta, gigantes, taramasalata, melitzanosalata, spanakorizo, loukoumades and baklava. With olive oil, lemon, oregano and dill.

packs.name: World cuisine: India
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Curries, pulses, breads and sweets from India: butter chicken, tandoori chicken, rogan josh, korma, vindaloo, palak paneer, chana masala, dal tadka, rajma, aloo gobi, baingan bharta, samosas, onion bhajis, raita, mint chutney, chapatis, aloo paratha, kheer, mango lassi and masala chai.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Indo-Chinese
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Indo-Chinese cooking, born among the Hakka Chinese of Kolkata and now at every street stall in India: gobi manchurian, chilli chicken, Hakka noodles, Schezwan fried rice, chilli paneer, manchow soup, sweetcorn soup and honey chilli potatoes.

packs.name: World cuisine: Indonesia
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Everyday and festive dishes from Indonesia: nasi goreng, mie goreng, chicken satay with peanut sauce, gado-gado, rendang, soto ayam, opor ayam, bakso, sayur lodeh, sambal and sweets such as pisang goreng, martabak and klepon. With substitutes for the less common ingredients.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Italian-American
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The cooking of Italian immigrants in New York, New Jersey and San Francisco, more generous with meat, cheese and sauce than Italy's: spaghetti and meatballs, chicken parmesan, penne alla vodka, fettuccine Alfredo, baked ziti, shrimp scampi, cioppino and Italian wedding soup.

packs.name: World cuisine: Italy
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The great classics of Italy's regions: carbonara, amatriciana, cacio e pepe, lasagne, pasta alla Norma, spaghetti with clams, risotto alla milanese, ossobuco, saltimbocca, parmigiana, minestrone, pasta e fagioli, pizza margherita, focaccia, arancini, vitello tonnato, caponata, puttanesca, orecchiette with turnip tops, gnocchi alla sorrentina, chicken cacciatore, ribollita, panzanella, carpaccio, calzone, tiramisu, panna cotta, cannoli and cantucci. Made the Italian way, with no cream in the carbonara.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Italian-Peruvian
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: What 19th-century Ligurian immigrants left on the Peruvian table, mixed with Andean chillies, potatoes and cheeses: tallarines rojos, tallarines a la huancaína with lomo saltado, menestrón, chard pie, yellow potato gnocchi and panetón.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Japanese-Chinese
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Chūka ryōri, the Japanese-style Chinese cooking of the Chinatowns of Yokohama and Nagasaki and of neighbourhood restaurants: chāhan, tenshinhan, ebi chili, ebi mayo, hiyashi chūka, Nagasaki champon, shūmai and nira reba.

packs.name: World cuisine: Japan
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Japanese home cooking: miso soup, chicken teriyaki, gyoza, ramen, tonkatsu, oyakodon, onigiri, tamagoyaki, okonomiyaki, yakitori, tempura, maki rolls, karaage, nikujaga, yakisoba, gyudon, Japanese curry and dorayaki. With dashi and the basic sauces explained step by step.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Korean-Chinese
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The dishes of Korea's Chinese restaurants, created by Shandong immigrants in Incheon and ordered for delivery all over the country: jajangmyeon, jjamppong, tangsuyuk, kkanpunggi, lajogi, yusanseul, gun-mandu and goguma mattang.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Malaysian Chinese
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The cooking of Malaysia's Chinese (Hokkien, Cantonese, Hainanese and Hakka) at the hawker stalls of Penang and Kuala Lumpur: char kway teow, bak kut teh, Hokkien mee, yong tau foo, claypot chicken rice, wantan mee, Hainanese chicken chop and kaya toast.

packs.name: Mediterranean cooking
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Recipes from around the Mediterranean: Spain, Italy, Greece, Lebanon, Morocco and Tunisia. Gazpacho, paella, Spanish omelette, moussaka, hummus, falafel, shakshuka, risotto, tagine and more, with olive oil, seasonal vegetables and pulses.

packs.name: World cuisine: Mexico
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Mexican classics to cook at home: tacos al pastor, cochinita pibil, pozole, chilaquiles, enchiladas, salsas, guacamole, aguas frescas and flan. With easy-to-find ingredients and alternatives where needed.

packs.name: Panadería
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Panes y bollería para hacer en casa, de la masa madre a las magdalenas: hogaza de masa madre, barra, pan de molde, integral, de centeno, chapata, pan de nueces y pasas, pita, naan, bagels, panecillos de hamburguesa, bollos de leche, brioche, cruasanes, napolitanas de chocolate, ensaimadas, tortas de aceite, magdalenas y rosquillas de anís. Con pesos exactos y tiempos de levado.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Peranakan
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The Nyonya cooking of the Peranakan, descendants of Chinese and Malays in Malacca, Penang and Singapore, which blends Chinese techniques with spices, coconut and tamarind: laksa lemak, asam laksa, ayam pongteh, ayam buah keluak, otak-otak, kueh pie tee, chap chye and kuih dadar.

packs.name: World cuisine: Peru
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Peruvian cooking from the coast, the Andes and the chifa tradition: ceviche, tiradito, lomo saltado, ají de gallina, causa limeña, papa a la huancaína, ocopa, arroz chaufa, anticuchos, pollo a la brasa, rocoto relleno, seco de res, arroz con pollo, chupe de camarones, papa rellena, tallarines verdes, suspiro limeño, picarones, mazamorra morada and chicha morada. With substitutes for Peruvian chillies.

packs.name: Rice dishes
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Paellas, dry, creamy and soupy Spanish rices and rice dishes from around the world: seafood, mixed and vegetable paella, arroz del senyoret, arroz a banda, rice with rabbit and snails, crusted rice, soupy lobster rice, creamy mushroom rice, arroz empedrado, Murcian garden rice, Cuban-style rice, pilaf, biryani, pumpkin risotto, gallo pinto, arroz con gandules and jollof. And there is no chorizo in any paella.

packs.name: World cuisine: Spain
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: A tour of Spain's regional cooking: cocido madrileño, fabada, lentil stew, marmitako, bacalao al pil pil, garlic chicken, black rice, fideuà, oven-baked rice, escalivada, Rioja-style potatoes, Galician broth, papas arrugadas with mojo, ajoblanco, Galician empanada, migas, oxtail stew, torrijas, rice pudding and Santiago almond cake. Without repeating the dishes in the Mediterranean, tapas and Christmas packs.

packs.name: Spanish tapas
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Bar tapas from all over Spain to share: patatas bravas, Padrón peppers, Galician-style octopus, marinated anchovies, fried squid rings, shrimp fritters, mushroom croquettes, chorizo in cider, pinchos morunos, huevos rotos, Russian salad, gildas and pan con tomate, among others.

packs.name: Tapas españolas
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Tapas de bar de toda España para compartir: patatas bravas, pimientos de Padrón, pulpo a la gallega, boquerones en vinagre, calamares a la romana, tortillitas de camarones, croquetas de setas, chorizo a la sidra, pinchos morunos, huevos rotos, ensaladilla, gildas y pan con tomate, entre otras.

packs.name: Fusion cuisine: Tex-Mex
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: The cooking of Texans of Mexican descent, with more yellow cheese, cumin and beef than Mexico's: nachos, chile con queso, cheese enchiladas with chili gravy, crispy beef tacos, breakfast tacos, King Ranch chicken, Frito pie and sopaipillas.

packs.name: World cuisine: Thailand
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Thailand's balance of hot, sour, sweet and salty: pad thai, tom yum, tom kha gai, green, massaman and panang curries, som tam, larb, fried rice, pad kra pao, pad see ew, cashew chicken, beef salad, fish cakes, Thai omelette, khao man gai, gai yang, jaew dipping sauce, mango sticky rice and Thai iced tea. With substitutes for the less common ingredients.

packs.name: Thermomix: cremas y purés
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Cremas y purés programados para Thermomix TM6 (vaso de 2,2 litros), que funcionan igual en TM5 y TM7. Calabaza, verduras, vichyssoise, champiñones, zanahoria con jengibre, brócoli, espárragos, guisantes con menta, tomate, lentejas rojas, coliflor, espinacas, boniato, alcachofas, pimientos asados, castañas, apio nabo, alubias, remolacha y puré de patatas. En TM31 (vaso de 2 litros y 100 °C como máximo), sofríe a temperatura Varoma.

packs.name: Thermomix: soups and purées
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Smooth soups and purées programmed for the Thermomix TM6 (2.2 litre bowl), which work just the same on the TM5 and TM7. Pumpkin, mixed vegetable, vichyssoise, mushroom, carrot and ginger, broccoli, asparagus, pea and mint, tomato, red lentil, cauliflower, spinach, sweet potato, artichoke, roasted pepper, chestnut, celeriac, white bean, beetroot and mashed potato. On a TM31 (2 litre bowl, 100 °C maximum), fry at Varoma temperature.

packs.name: World cuisine: Vietnam
packs.author: Miga
packs.description: Vietnam's fresh, fragrant cooking, from Hanoi to Saigon: phở, bún chả, bánh mì, fresh and fried spring rolls, bún bò Huế, cơm tấm, caramelised fish and pork, sour soup, shaking beef, lemongrass chilli chicken, bánh xèo, chicken salad, bún thịt nướng, nước chấm, tofu in tomato sauce and, for dessert, banana in coconut milk, iced coffee with condensed milk and avocado smoothie.
